prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-16, before any result was read; follows rs-kit-trip-development. Descriptive development study. Primary endpoint: fewer natural deaths first. Then mean final character level, mean deepest level and the DL5+ count, including dead characters. Every result is reported per class, because the plan differs by class. Paired rescued and newly killed counts against reborn-m13-control for each arm. Factorial effects: plan, shopping and plan x shopping. Incomplete, config_error and borg_stopped cells are reported separately. Nothing here confirms a winner; that needs a fresh confirmation suite.
